caption: The drawing depicts a tall wooden grandfather clock with a reddish-brown body and dark brown trim at the top, middle, and base, standing upright to the left side of the composition. The clock has a rectangular lower section with a door in the midsection and a raised panel at the bottom. The upper section houses a large, arched clock face with black Roman numerals and two black hands. Surrounding the clock face are floral decorations, and above the dial, within the arch, is an oval medallion containing a painted image of a brown deer on a light green background, flanked by gold motifs. Below the center of the clock face is the inscription “George Hoff, Lancaster.” To the right of the grandfather clock, there is a larger, detailed inset illustration of just the clock face, showing the floral and decorative elements more clearly. The background of the entire composition is light and unadorned, and the artist's signature, “STANLEY MAZUR,” appears in the lower right corner.
title: Grandfather Clock
